title: Rubber Ducky Isopod
description:
Offering one (1) unsexed Rubber Ducky Isopod. These originate from the limestone caves of Thailand and are prized for their unique morphology and "designer" aesthetic.
​Species: Cubaris sp.
​Size: Sub-adult (Perfect for acclimating to a new environment).
​Care Level: Intermediate (Requires high humidity, supplemental calcium, and leaf litter).
​Health: Active, eating well on a diet of organic leaf litter, decaying wood, and calcium supplements.
​Note: This listing is for a single individual, perfect for those looking to add genetic diversity to an existing colony or for a dedicated nano-display.
